stem: The position vector of a particle is given as $\overrightarrow{r} = \left( t^{2} - 4t + 6 \right)\widehat{i} + (t^{2})\widehat{j}$. The time ‘t’ when the velocity vector and acceleration vector become perpendicular to each other is?

assets.alt: x–y axes: a path starting at t = 0 on the x-axis, curving left and then up. At t = 1, at (3, 1), the velocity −2î + 2ĵ points up-left and the acceleration 2î + 2ĵ points up-right.
